subject: PulseHealth implementation bridge — context, owners, and kickoff
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Alex Ramirez <alex@pulsehealth.com>, Emily Soto <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: sales_ops@redwood.inference
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PulseHealth implementation bridge — context, owners, and kickoff

Hi all,

Happy to hand this across — PulseHealth (DEAL-8841) went verbal last week. Quick summary and open items for CS/Implementation:

- Contract & scope: SOW attached (PulseHealth_SOW_v1.pdf). Commercial terms are straightforward; legal will need a final sign. Karthik — tagging you for final doc edits and signature cadence.
- Timeline: Customer wants a staged rollout starting the week of 2025-08-04 (pilot with 3 models → full rollout in 8 weeks).
- Technical context: PulseHealth will host data in us-west-2; their infra team (Alex) has requested a short network requirements doc and a whitelist for IPs.
- Data / Security: PulseHealth completed our security questionnaire (attached). They asked about audit log retention and key management options.
- Success metrics: initial SLA target of 99.5% availability for inference endpoints; goal is 100k tokens/day by week 6.

Open items / asks for CS/Implementation:
1) Please confirm overall owner for the engagement and the deployment lead who will run the kickoff.
2) Ben — can you review infra checklist and flag any additional prerequisites?
3) Marissa — can you propose 60/90 day success criteria and runbook owners?
4) Karthik — we need SOW + DocuSign link finalized by 2025-07-18 to hit the August kickoff.

Attachments: PulseHealth_SOW_v1.pdf, PulseHealth_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.docx

Alex/Emily — copied our CS and implementation leads. If there are any other internal stakeholders you want to include for the kickoff, reply-all and we’ll loop them in.

Thanks — I’ll remain on thread for the first round of coordination.

Best,
Chloe

--
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Alex Ramirez <alex@pulsehealth.com>, Emily Soto <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: cs_ops@redwood.inference
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseHealth implementation bridge — context, owners, and kickoff

Thanks Chloe — great summary.

Acknowledging ownership: I will act as overall CS Owner for PulseHealth (primary escalation and success lead). Ben will be the deployment lead responsible for technical prep and the kickoff runbook. Karthik, please keep legal looped for SOW finalization.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben and I will review the attached SOW and security questionnaire today and flag gaps.
- Let's target a kickoff week of 2025-07-28 with a 60-minute technical + success alignment session (pilot scope, KPIs, roles, comms). If the 28th doesn't work, alternate options are 2025-07-30 or 2025-08-03.
- I’ll draft success criteria and owner list (60/90 day) and share by 2025-07-16.

Alex/Emily — do any of those kickoff windows work for your team? For the kickoff we’ll need: one technical lead (for network & infra), one product owner (for feature prioritization during pilot), and a security/compliance point of contact.

Quoting Chloe for context: 
> - Contract & scope: SOW attached (PulseHealth_SOW_v1.pdf). Commercial terms are straightforward; legal will need a final sign. Karthik — tagging you for final doc edits and signature cadence.

We’ll follow up with an invite once Ben confirms dev availability.

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Alex Ramirez <alex@pulsehealth.com>, Emily Soto <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: infra_team@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseHealth implementation bridge — context, owners, and kickoff

Thanks — assigning myself as deployment lead. I reviewed the security questionnaire and Chloe’s notes; a few technical items to call out:

- Network: we’ll provide a small IP whitelist and TLS cert requirements. Alex, can you confirm whether PulseHealth prefers a private endpoint (VPC peering) or public with IP allowlist? That will change our timeline by ~1 week.
- Model variants: suggest we start with the quantized medium model for pilot to save costs while validating latency. Will require a simple prompt/quality checklist from PulseHealth.
- Data handling: we need confirmation on whether logs can be shared with our observability tool or must be pushed to their S3.
- Infra pre-reqs: I attached an infra checklist (infra-checklist.xlsx) — items 1–5 should be completed before kickoff.

Tentative kickoff times (PST):
- Tuesday 2025-07-29, 10:00–11:00
- Thursday 2025-07-31, 09:00–10:00

Alex/Emily — which of these slots looks better for the infra/product folks? If neither, propose 3 slots and we’ll pick one.

On forwarding Chloe’s earlier asks: Karthik — do you expect DocuSign ready by 2025-07-18 if we resolve the single SOW appendix?

Best,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Deployment Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Alex Ramirez <alex@pulsehealth.com>, Emily Soto <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseHealth implementation bridge — context, owners, and kickoff

Thanks everyone — good progress.

Alex/Emily — Marissa and Ben will lead kickoff. Ben proposed 2025-07-29 10:00 PST as first choice; please confirm and I’ll send an invite. Karthik will push the SOW/DocuSign by 2025-07-18 and loop legal.

Action items recap:
- Marissa: 60/90 day success criteria and runbook owners (due 2025-07-16).
- Ben: validate infra checklist and confirm private endpoint vs IP allowlist (due 2025-07-17).
- Karthik: finalize SOW + DocuSign link (due 2025-07-18).
- Alex/Emily: confirm kickoff slot and internal attendees (reply by 2025-07-16).

Chloe (staying on thread) — I’ll close the loop after the kickoff invite is sent.

Thanks,
Chloe

--
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
